Defined in: [packages/ai/src/activities/generate3DModel/index.ts:165](https://github.com/TanStack/ai/blob/main/packages/ai/src/activities/generate3DModel/index.ts#L165)

**`Experimental`**

Options for [generate3DModel](../functions/generate3DModel.md).

- No `stream` and no `wait`: submit the job and return `{ jobId, model }`.
- `stream: true`: run the full job and return StreamChunks (for SSE).
- `wait: true`: run the full job and return the finished model.

`stream` and `wait` cannot both be `true`.
